executive_summary.headline: Southbridge should start with invoice help in Finance and case-note help in Programmes in the next thirty days.

key_findings.text: Invoice processing is the slowest task in Finance.
Case notes and funder reports take Programmes staff hours each week.
Trustees want a clear consent and data plan before any rollout.
Data foundations score lowest of the themes, at 1.8, with low confidence.

executive_summary.summary_paragraph: Southbridge is at an early stage with AI. Its work is well run in Finance and Programmes, but its data is weak and it has no IT team. Two pilots would save the most time. One helps Finance with invoices. The other helps Programmes write case notes. Both can start with tools the charity already uses. The trustees will back this if a plan for consent and data comes first. We suggest a thirty-day pilot in one Finance task, run alongside a data protection impact assessment.

items.title: Invoice pilot in Finance
items.kill_criterion: invoice time does not fall by a quarter in four weeks

items.title: Onboarding checklist assistant
items.kill_criterion: volunteers do not use it within a month

actions.action: Map three Finance invoice tasks and pick one for a pilot
actions.kill_criterion: stop if no task takes more than two hours a week

actions.action: Start a data protection impact assessment for the pilot
actions.kill_criterion: stop the pilot if the DPIA finds a high risk we cannot reduce

actions.action: Run the invoice pilot with Google Workspace tools
actions.kill_criterion: stop if invoice time does not fall by a quarter in four weeks

actions.action: Draft case-note templates with an AI assistant, no beneficiary names
actions.kill_criterion: stop if staff spend longer checking notes than writing them

actions.action: Decide whether to keep, change or stop each pilot
actions.kill_criterion: stop any pilot that missed its target

actions.action: Write a one-page AI use policy for staff and volunteers
actions.kill_criterion: stop if trustees do not approve it by day 90
